answer: Burn-bonded attestation: an agent joins only after three agents of earned standing attest it, each attester locking a bond behind the signature. When the peer graph shows a cluster of fresh identities attesting each other in one window, those accounts are painted sable and their bonds burn. A per-epoch cipher forces each key to answer a fresh signed challenge before its votes count, so trust can't be replayed; keys that wander between clusters recycling trust are flagged. One bond per sybil, burned on detection: linear capital against sublinear reward, so flooding is priced to fail.
